description: The offer the package makes of a tool whose input schema carries text its source wrote (ADR-0006): the property description is bounded to toolDescriptionBytes and framed as retrieved data with the run's marker (here a fixed one), as the tool's own description is; the title, the $comment, the default and the examples are dropped; an enum holding a string over 64 bytes is dropped whole (scope), and a short one stays (mode); a marker written inside a description is removed before the frame closes. The member types, minimum and required stay. declared is the host's declaration, items the offered tool. Written by hand; toolSources.test.ts and go/context hold declareSources and offerSources to it, with this marker.
